note:
No tolerances are recorded yet. The Golden Manifest for qwen3-tts-12hz-0-6b-customvoice is committed at suite_version 1 and stage 2 captures the oracle; per-stage numbers are measured at stage 5-port-validate and land here then, per profile and per Execution Backend.

Two constraints are already known and must shape this file when it is filled.

Deep talker layers need a cosine threshold rather than max-abs. Reading the reference port showed per-layer max-abs of 13.07 / 13.09 / 13.42 at L7 / L14 / L21 and 66.8 at L27 while cosine similarity held at or above 0.9998; those are outlier channels ahead of the final norm, and a max-abs threshold would report catastrophic failure on a correct port.

The code sequence is a structural probe, not a numeric one. Greedy decoding with both do_sample and subtalker_dosample false is bit-reproducible, so codes.semantic and codes.acoustic are compared for exact equality; any difference is a defect rather than drift.
